title: Engine Fire Over Phoenix, Delta's Wi-Fi Flip-Flop, and the FAA Meltdown Just Got Worse
summary: An American Airlines jet declares Mayday after another crew spots flames shooting from its engine over Phoenix. Delta's CEO does a stunning about-face on how much Wi-Fi actually matters, new reporting makes the FAA's ground stop look even messier, and one Southwest passenger learns the hard way what happens when your plus-one doesn't show up.
